routes.title: Route Analysis
routes.subtitle: Import a GPX file to analyse your route and estimate effort
routes.ridingConditionsHint: Uses your saved body weight and locally estimated FTP; no extra speed or training data is needed.
routes.emptyDescription: Import a GPX file to view offline route and effort estimates
routes.routePreviewHint: Confirm distance and elevation before navigation
routes.weatherFallback: Weather could not be retrieved; estimates use {{temp}}°C.
routes.offlinePlanningNote: Route estimates are calculated locally and should be adjusted for actual conditions.
routes.calorieFormula: Time, calories, and hydration use the same FTP, total mass, GPX grade, weather, and wind snapshot.
routes.estimatedWaterLossHint: Heat load, humidity, intensity, and climbing
routes.suggestedWaterHint: Uses the shared intensity and environmental load
routes.suggestedEnergyHint: Uses estimated duration and power intensity
routes.calorieNote: Plan hydration and fuel for actual riding conditions.
routes.gradientDistanceShare: Share of route distance in each range
routes.ridingTipHigh: This route climbs {{ascent}} m and is estimated to use {{calories}} kcal. Plan hydration and fuel at your planned stops.
routes.ridingTipMedium: This route includes moderate climbing and is estimated to use {{calories}} kcal. Prepare water and fuel from the unified estimate.
routes.ridingTipLow: This route is mostly flat and is estimated to use {{calories}} kcal. Plan fuel from the estimated fluid and energy needs.

audit.addressPlaceholder: Enter an address, landmark, or business

audit.routeServiceUnavailableBody: Check your network and try again. The latest road data will be used when replanning.
audit.clearNavigationLayersBody: This removes the imported GPX, every pinned navigation route, start/end markers, and direction arrows.
audit.noConfirmedSupply: No confirmed fuel or hydration was recorded for this ride.
audit.localPhotoTimelineHint: Only the photos you explicitly select are added. Your full library is not read or uploaded.
audit.noRidePhotos: No photos have been added to this ride.
audit.elevationChartEmpty: This activity does not have enough GPS elevation data to draw an elevation chart.

audit.speedCurveEmpty: This activity does not have enough samples to draw an analysis curve.
audit.estimatedCurveNote: Confidence is based on available data and local calibration history. Factors: {{factors}}. For trend review only; this is not an external sensor measurement.
audit.returnToStandardMode: Tap anywhere to return to standard mode

audit.errorDescription: Your current ride data is kept locally. Try opening this screen again; if the issue persists, restart Cycling Assistant.
